[**A Dog’s Life**\\ \\ This exhibition celebrates the enduring bond between humans and their canine companions\\ \\ Open until 15th November](https://www.leicestermuseums.org/DogsLife)

[**Open: The People’s Exhibition 2026**\\ \\ The annual showcase of artistic talent from Leicester and the East Midlands\\ \\ Opening 28 November 2026](https://www.leicestermuseums.org/Open2026)

[**Guildhall Christmas Craft Fair**\\ \\ A unique Christmas shopping experience in the beautiful Guildhall\\ \\ Leicester Guildhall](https://www.leicestermuseums.org/GuildhallChristmasCraft2026)

[**Leicester Windrush Memories**\\ \\ An exhibition commemorating, congratulating, and celebrating the Windrush Generation\\ \\ Free exhibition](https://www.leicestermuseums.org/LeicesterWindrushMemories)

[**Christmas Steam Day**\\ \\ Enjoy vintage vehicles and toys from Christmases past, a festive bass band, crafts and so much more!\\ \\ Abbey Pumping Station](https://www.leicestermuseums.org/event-details/?id=6fef2d70-361a-42af-84d0-00d0df4f9b2b)
